summary: Freightos Limited filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing its Q2 2026 financial results, including record revenue of $7.7 million, an Adjusted EBITDA loss of -$2.0 million, and cash of $21.4 million. CEO and CFO Pablo Pinillos commented on operational progress and profitability targets, aiming for Adjusted EBITDA breakeven by year-end and cash generation by mid-2027. The filing contains routine quarterly results and updated guidance, with no transaction, strategic review, or corporate action. It is a standard earnings announcement with no special-situation elements requiring further analysis.
